BMI was 30.4 on August 6, 2026 [Observation/GLP1-009-BMI-2026-08-06]. Since September 2025, the patient has participated in a dietitian-led weight-management program with calorie tracking, dietary changes, and a gym routine targeting approximately 150 minutes per week [DocumentReference/GLP1-009-PCP-001, DocumentReference/GLP1-009-NUTR-001, DocumentReference/GLP1-009-NUTR-002, DocumentReference/GLP1-009-PCP-003].
